entries.en: This documentation remains readable as source files, but interactive planning controls require JavaScript. No analytics or trackers are used.
entries.yue: 呢份文件即使當原始檔睇都仲讀得到，不過互動規劃控制需要 JavaScript。冇使用分析工具或者追蹤器。
搜尋所選群組入面嘅分頁

entries.en: See where your hair could be next month, then reset the estimate when you get a haircut.
entries.yue: 睇吓下個月頭髮可能去到邊，剪完髮再重設估算，一剪一算好清楚。

entries.en: This website is a landing, documentation, download, status, settings, and link surface. It is not the primary desktop application, it does not embed the installed application, and it does not replace the local service.
entries.yue: 呢個網站提供介紹、文件、下載、狀態、設定同連結。佢唔係主要桌面應用程式，唔會嵌入已安裝嘅應用程式，亦唔會取代本機服務。
試用瀏覽器本機估算器
真實男士頭髮參考階段
參考相片準備中，頭髮未行入鏡住

entries.en: Stage references animate only when local image assets are present.
entries.yue: 只有本機圖像素材齊備時，階段參考先會郁。

entries.en: Project from a dated baseline using a configurable monthly rate and a target length.
entries.yue: 由有日期嘅基準開始，配合可調每月生長率同目標長度去推算。

entries.en: Record the post-cut length and date. The newest valid haircut becomes the active baseline while the manual fallback remains available.
entries.yue: 記低剪髮後長度同日期。最新有效剪髮會成為目前基準，手動後備基準亦會繼續保留。

entries.en: Run locally, on a private LAN host, or behind a strict SSH tunnel. Public exposure is not a supported default.
entries.yue: 可以喺本機、私密 LAN 主機，或者嚴格 SSH 隧道後面執行。預設唔支援公開暴露。

entries.en: Export browser-local planning state in JSON, CSV, Markdown, HTML, YAML, TOML, XML, SQL, and source-code forms.
entries.yue: 將瀏覽器本機規劃狀態匯出成 JSON、CSV、Markdown、HTML、YAML、TOML、XML、SQL 同原始碼格式。

entries.en: These values stay in this browser. They do not write to the desktop application or service.
entries.yue: 呢啲數值只會留喺呢個瀏覽器，唔會寫入桌面應用程式或者服務。

entries.en: The adjustable 1.0 cm/month starting estimate is informed by the general scalp-hair figure in
entries.yue: 可調嘅 1.0 cm/month 起始估算，參考咗以下來源嘅一般頭皮頭髮數字：

entries.en: . Individual growth varies meaningfully. This planner is not medical advice and cannot predict an individual's actual growth.
entries.yue: 。每個人嘅生長速度可以相差好多。呢個規劃器唔係醫療建議，亦無法預測個別人士嘅實際生長。

entries.en: Used when no valid haircut record remains. Future dates are not accepted.
entries.yue: 冇有效剪髮記錄剩低時使用。唔接受未來日期，時光機未包。

entries.en: The manual fallback is the active baseline.
entries.yue: 目前使用手動後備基準。

entries.en: Enter a factual baseline to calculate a projection.
entries.yue: 輸入有根有據嘅基準，先可以計算推算結果。

entries.en: The newest valid haircut is the active browser-local baseline. Editing or deleting records recalculates that choice, and the retained manual fallback resumes when no valid haircut remains. Desktop and server records remain separate.
entries.yue: 最新有效剪髮會成為目前瀏覽器本機基準。編輯或者刪除記錄會重新計算呢個選擇，冇有效剪髮記錄時就會恢復保留嘅手動後備基準。桌面同伺服器記錄繼續分開。

entries.en: Choose today or an earlier date.
entries.yue: 選擇今日或者更早嘅日期。

entries.en: The service binds to loopback by default. Non-loopback binding requires a strong API key and an explicit private-network decision.
entries.yue: 服務預設只綁定 loopback。非 loopback 綁定需要高強度 API key，同埋明確嘅私密網絡決定。

entries.en: for the smallest network surface. Data remains on one computer.
entries.yue: ，令網絡暴露面最細。資料只留喺一部電腦。

entries.en: Bind deliberately, require an API key, restrict firewall access, and never forward the port from a public router.
entries.yue: 要明確綁定、要求 API key、限制防火牆存取，而且永遠唔好由公共路由器轉送連接埠。

entries.en: Forward a loopback service through OpenSSH with persistent known-host verification. A changed key stops the connection.
entries.yue: 透過 OpenSSH 轉送 loopback 服務，並使用持久 known-host 驗證。金鑰一有變更，連線就會停止。

entries.en: through a private environment source before any non-loopback deployment. Do not commit it.
entries.yue: ，並喺任何非 loopback 部署之前透過私密環境來源提供。唔好提交入版本庫。

entries.en: HTTP is suitable only for loopback or a separately protected private network.
entries.yue: HTTP 只適合 loopback，或者另有保護嘅私密網絡。

entries.en: SSH passwords are not accepted by the desktop connection workflow. Use a key and persistent known-host verification.
entries.yue: 桌面連線流程唔接受 SSH 密碼。請使用金鑰同持久 known-host 驗證。

entries.en: This website cannot connect to or control the installed service without an explicit browser request and compatible local CORS settings.
entries.yue: 如果冇明確瀏覽器請求同相容嘅本機 CORS 設定，呢個網站就無法連接或者控制已安裝服務。

entries.en: A download appears only after an immutable release manifest is built and verified.
entries.yue: 只有建立同驗證不可變發行清單之後，下載先會出現。
等緊第一個已驗證發行

entries.en: No installer URL has been verified for this website artifact.
entries.yue: 呢個網站成品仲未有經驗證嘅安裝程式 URL。

entries.en: The button remains disabled until build provenance includes an immutable HTTPS release asset and SHA-256 digest.
entries.yue: 按鈕會保持停用，直至建置來源資料包含不可變 HTTPS 發行素材同 SHA-256 摘要。

entries.en: The installed application checks an unsigned Squirrel.Windows HTTPS feed, validates metadata and package hashes, and asks before restart. It does not claim a publisher signature. The website reports release facts but does not install updates.
entries.yue: 已安裝應用程式會檢查未簽署嘅 Squirrel.Windows HTTPS feed，驗證中繼資料同套件雜湊，並喺重新啟動前詢問。佢唔會聲稱有發行者簽署。網站只會報告發行事實，唔會安裝更新。

entries.en: Articles are compiled into this website artifact. Searching and reading them works offline after the page has loaded.
entries.yue: 文章已編譯入呢個網站成品。頁面載入之後，離線都可以搜尋同閱讀。

entries.en: The article list will appear after build composition.
entries.yue: 建置組合完成之後，文章清單就會出現。

entries.en: These utilities operate on user-selected local data. They do not upload files.
entries.yue: 呢啲工具只處理由使用者揀選嘅本機資料，唔會上載檔案。

entries.en: Documents/PDF, adapter unavailable in this browser build
entries.yue: 文件/PDF，呢個瀏覽器建置未有可用 adapter

entries.en: Images, adapter unavailable in this browser build
entries.yue: 圖像，呢個瀏覽器建置未有可用 adapter

entries.en: Audio, adapter unavailable in this browser build
entries.yue: 音訊，呢個瀏覽器建置未有可用 adapter

entries.en: Video, adapter unavailable in this browser build
entries.yue: 影片，呢個瀏覽器建置未有可用 adapter

entries.en: Archives, adapter unavailable in this browser build
entries.yue: 封存檔，呢個瀏覽器建置未有可用 adapter

entries.en: Maximum source size is 1 MiB. Processing is local, bounded to one file in this browser surface, cancellable before download, and never overwrites the source.
entries.yue: 來源檔案上限係 1 MiB。處理只喺本機進行，呢個瀏覽器畫面每次只處理一個檔案，下載前可以取消，而且永遠唔會覆寫來源檔案。

entries.en: A public HTTPS page cannot start local processes, inspect hardware, bypass browser mixed-content rules, or promise CORS access. This browser-local equivalent can make an explicit user-requested loopback API call, store local profiles, and report the exact browser refusal.
entries.yue: 公共 HTTPS 頁面無法啟動本機程序、檢查硬件、繞過瀏覽器 mixed-content 規則，亦唔可以保證 CORS 存取。呢個瀏覽器本機等效功能可以按使用者明確要求呼叫 loopback API、儲存本機設定檔，並準確報告瀏覽器拒絕原因。

entries.en: Exhaustive remote store refresh is disabled because the site has no trusted catalog proxy.
entries.yue: 由於網站冇可信任嘅目錄代理，完整遠端商店重新整理已停用。

entries.en: Hardware-fit verdicts remain Unknown because a browser cannot reliably inspect RAM, VRAM, drivers, and blob metadata.
entries.yue: 硬件配合判斷會保持 Unknown，因為瀏覽器無法可靠檢查 RAM、VRAM、驅動程式同 blob 中繼資料。

entries.en: Batch pull, deletion, and harness launch require the installed application and explicit local process controls.
entries.yue: 批量 pull、刪除同 harness 啟動需要已安裝應用程式，以及明確嘅本機程序控制。
瀏覽器本機 TOTP 驗證器

entries.en: This website uses localStorage rather than an operating-system credential vault. That is not suitable for valuable account secrets. Prefer a dedicated authenticator. Clearing this site's storage removes entries.
entries.yue: 呢個網站使用 localStorage，而唔係作業系統憑證保管庫。唔適合儲存重要帳戶密鑰，請優先使用專用驗證器。清除呢個網站嘅儲存資料會移除項目。
otpauth URI 或 Base32 密鑰

entries.en: QR image decoding and camera access are visible but unavailable in this static build because no verified local decoder is bundled.
entries.yue: QR 圖片解碼同相機存取會顯示，但喺呢個靜態版本中無法使用，因為未有隨附經驗證嘅本機解碼器。

entries.en: Unavailable: no bundled QR decoder has packaged-artifact proof.
entries.yue: 無法使用：冇隨附具套件成品證據嘅 QR 解碼器。

entries.en: Exports include browser-local settings, estimates, haircut records, notifications, and redacted history. Authenticator secrets, lock credentials, private vocabulary mappings, and custom-logo bytes are omitted and identified as omitted. CSV and TSV use normalized long-form rows with JSON Pointer paths, JSON values, representation metadata, and the same explicit privacy omissions.
entries.yue: 匯出內容包括瀏覽器本機設定、估算、剪髮記錄、通知同已遮蓋敏感資料嘅歷史。驗證器密鑰、鎖定憑證、私人詞彙對應同自訂標誌位元組會省略，亦會清楚標明已省略。CSV 同 TSV 會使用正規化長格式資料列，包含 JSON Pointer 路徑、JSON 值、表示中繼資料，同樣清楚列出私隱省略項目。
匯出已遮蓋敏感資料嘅瀏覽器狀態

entries.en: Every claim is tied to the provenance embedded in this built website artifact.
entries.yue: 每項聲明都會連結到內嵌喺呢個已建置網站成品嘅來源資料。

entries.en: No immutable installer manifest is embedded yet.
entries.yue: 仲未內嵌不可變安裝程式清單。

entries.en: Built-artifact screenshots and per-click evidence are recorded separately during release verification.
entries.yue: 已建置成品嘅畫面擷取同逐次點擊證據，會喺發行驗證期間分開記錄。

entries.en: This static website has no authenticated session bridge, so it cannot send answers or mutate project status.
entries.yue: 呢個靜態網站冇已驗證工作階段橋接，所以無法傳送答案或者變更專案狀態。
只可附加嘅瀏覽器記錄

entries.en: History is stored in this browser only. Same-origin tabs reconcile monotonic revisions through an exclusive browser transaction and refuse stale writes. Nothing synchronizes to another device or server, and clearing site storage removes it.
entries.yue: 歷史只會儲存喺呢個瀏覽器。Same-origin 分頁會透過獨佔瀏覽器交易協調單調遞增修訂，並拒絕過時寫入。唔會同步去其他裝置或者伺服器，清除網站儲存空間就會移除記錄。

entries.en: Browser revision unavailable until local state initializes.
entries.yue: 本機狀態初始化之前，瀏覽器修訂資料暫時未有。
匯出已遮蓋敏感資料嘅歷史

entries.en: Entries are compiled from the repository record. Unknown commit links stay visibly unavailable rather than being guessed.
entries.yue: 項目由版本庫記錄編譯而成。未知提交連結會清楚顯示為不可用，唔會靠估。
